name: job_output
description: Fetch the result or current status of a user job created with request_user_job, by its `job_id`. Returns the user's report if the job is completed, or a status line if it is still pending or was killed.

job_id.description: The job id returned by request_user_job (e.g. ujob_...).

prompt: job_output: read the result or status of a user job (created via request_user_job) by its `job_id`. Returns the user's report when completed, otherwise a status line.
